entities.name: Aysun Özbek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aysun Özbek is a Turkish retired volleyball player. She is 185 cm tall and weighs 73 kg. Playing in the middle blocker position, she played for Vakıfbank Güneş Sigorta since 1996. She wore the number 5 jersey and was the team's captain.
